gates: Supply an actual loopback host, available model, and explicitly opted-in disposable fixture project/source conversation.

definitions.correctness: Exact JSON output for UTC conversion, two decimal amounts, and no extra fields. Reject recorded operations and writable grants; this inline-input study does not independently measure source-file preservation.
definitions.recallUsefulness: Fraction of treatment outputs that are correct and whose captured request selected only the pinned policy. This is an operational proxy, not a causal truth claim.
definitions.auxiliaryCost: All reported extraction and consolidation spend for the dedicated fixture project, including setup. Unknown cost or pending cleanup remains null.
definitions.foregroundCost: RuntimeUsage does not specify cumulative versus per-run counters. Preserve warmup and task snapshots without subtracting them; attributed foreground charges and tokens remain null.
definitions.foregroundSubmissions: Attempted message.send submissions, including warmup and uncertain transport outcomes. This is not a provider-call count.
definitions.control: The same policy in existing thread notes, with every project-memory revision excluded from that exact prepared request.
definitions.ordering: Alternating control/treatment order across three fixed tasks. Each arm uses a fresh thread and identical READY warmup with the pinned thinking level; missing warmup capture or any recalled memory rejects the study.
